# Zack Nisbet

Zack Nisbet is a founder, software engineer, and operator. His full name is Zackary Paul Nisbet.

Canonical URL: https://zacknisbet.com/

Alternate domain: https://zackarynisbet.com/ should redirect to https://zacknisbet.com/

Current public work:
- Founder, Rammenta

Professional experience:
- Co-Founder, Director of Resorts at Luxury Pet Hotel Investments, Dec 2023 to Jun 2026; remains co-founder/investor
- Former Solutions Architect at Wolfspeed

Education:
- Master of Management Studies, Duke University - The Fuqua School of Business
- Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity, minor in Computer Science, SUNY Polytechnic Institute
